prevention_rule: 1. Treat LiDAR *scan freshness* as a first-class health signal, independent of the last range value. If scans stop for longer than the short memory window, fail to "LiDAR offline" in every direction and never keep advertising a latched 0.19 m (or any last range) as a live obstacle. 2. Voice / Jarvis UI should say that LiDAR is stale or offline when the trip reason is "no LiDAR", not only "Guard, I
root_cause_summary: The `sclidar` ROS 2 node inside the MentorPi container silently stopped publishing LaserScan messages for about 56 minutes. It did not crash the `gb-guard` or `gb-gate` systemd units, so those services stayed "active" while their last ranges froze (front 0.192 m, sweep 0.193 m). When John tried to drive manually, the gate correctly refused reverse because it had no rear LiDAR sense, and the voice
symptom: John tried to manually drive Wall-E and got the spoken / UI message "Guard, I held still". The safety gate blocked the command. At the moment of the trip, front range was stuck at 0.192 m (sweep 0.193 m) and the trip reason was "no LiDAR: reverse refused (no rear sense)".
title: sclidar dropout left stale 0.19m front and blocked manual drive
